description: Are you an experienced and compassionate nursing leader ready to make a significant impact? A premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA, is actively seeking a dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead its clinical team. This is an exceptional opportunity to shape patient care standards and foster a supportive environment for both residents and staff. We are looking for a visionary leader who is passionate about delivering high-quality healthcare outcomes.In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations, and developing a team of skilled nursing professionals. You will play a crucial part in maintaining the highest standards of resident care, implementing best practices, and driving continuous improvement initiatives within the facility.We are seeking to fill this role quickly and offer a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, commensurate with your experience and qualifications. Join a team committed to excellence and make a lasting difference in the lives of our residents.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, such as ADON or DON, preferably within a skilled nursing facility.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
Commitment to providing high-quality patient care and fostering a positive work environment.
salaryOrBonusInfo: $85,000 - $95,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
